scope.products: all active Shopify products and variants with live cost data
scope.formula: max($35 floor, (cost per item + $16 overhead) * cost-band multiplier, (cost per item + $16 overhead) / (1 - contribution margin)); round upward to .99
scope.variantPrices: calculate each variant independently from live cost; preserve variant and quantity differences
scope.compareAtPrices: preserve only valid existing compare-at prices above the new target; clear invalid values; never invent compare-at prices
scope.missingCostData: hold with explicit evidence and block price writes; never guess cost
scope.status: do not change product status or sales-channel inclusion
